name: (04) Necromancy (Vitreous Path) — 2 Intermediate — Breath of Thanatos

system.description: Spending one Blood Trait and one Willpower Trait and succeeding at a Simple Test, the necromancer expels an invisible entropic mist that draws Spectres to the area (radius one-quarter mile plus one-quarter mile per additional Blood Trait spent, centered on the necromancer, lasting up to a scene) without granting any control over them. Alternatively, focused into a touched target, or a ranged target defeated in a Physical Challenge (retest with Occult), it inflicts an aggravated wound and taints the victim with death energy until sunrise or sunset, imposing a two-Trait penalty on social interactions with those unfamiliar with death and marking her as a threat to werewolves and similarly sensitive beings. Failure risks the necromancer suffering the effects instead, worsening on consecutive failures.
system.duration: One scene (area) / until sunrise or sunset (infusion)
